name: Nicolásek
description: Nicolas: straight GOLDEN-BLOND hair (a warm golden-yellow blond — not platinum-pale, not honey/dirty-blond), hazel eyes (brown-green), fair light skin, white T-shirt with two red horizontal stripes, mid-blue denim shorts, white sneakers with grey soles, a 6-YEAR-OLD SCHOOL-AGE BOY — not a teenager, not a young adult, not a preschooler either. Draw him with genuine young-child proportions: a fairly large head-to-body ratio, a slim straight torso, not yet an athletic/lanky teenage build. If he looks like a teenager or an adult who merely got smaller, he has been drawn wrong.

name: Valentýnka
description: Valentýna: wavy light-blonde hair (a shade PALER than Nicolas's golden-blond) with large pink fabric bow, hazel eyes (a brown-green mix, not plain brown), fair light skin, yellow dress with small white flower print and white collar, white sandals, a TRUE 2-YEAR-OLD TODDLER — not a preschooler, not a similarly-aged child. Draw her with genuine toddler body proportions: a proportionally LARGER head relative to her body, shorter chubbier legs and arms, a rounder toddler tummy — NOT the leaner, longer-limbed proportions of a 5-6 year old. She is a full head shorter than Nicolas — the top of her head reaches only to his shoulders. If she looks like a similarly-proportioned child who is merely a bit shorter, she has been drawn too old — she must look visibly like a much younger toddler standing next to a school-age boy.

name: Táta Jan
description: Jan: adult man with a NOTICEABLY HIGH, RECEDED HAIRLINE across the WHOLE forehead (not just the temples) — short ESPRESSO-DARK-BROWN hair (noticeably darker than James's or Jakob's brown — the darkest hair color in the family) only starting well back from the brow, roughly a third of the way back across the scalp, exposing a tall bare forehead that covers over 40% of the visible head from a front view, NOT a full low hairline — if hair covers most of the front of the scalp with only the temples receding, that is WRONG, redraw with much more bare forehead (match the reference photos exactly, especially jan-face3.jpg). Thin, straight, NOT bushy eyebrows. Deep-set warm dark-brown eyes with visible fine character lines/creases at the outer corners even when smiling. A straight, moderate-width nose. A LEAN, NARROW, slightly angular jawline and chin — NOT a wide or heavy/strong jaw. Visible smile lines (nasolabial folds) framing the mouth even at rest, giving a mature, weathered-but-friendly look, not a smooth baby-face. Clean-shaven, NO beard, moustache or stubble of any kind. Fair light skin, big warm open smile, navy-blue polo shirt with white horizontal stripes, navy shorts, white sneakers, tall lean-athletic build (lean, not bulky).

name: Máma Jana
description: Jana: adult woman with very long straight PALE GOLDEN-BLONDE hair (same warm blond family as Nicolas and Valentýna, straight not wavy), blue-grey eyes, fair light skin, gentle smile, lilac-purple hoodie with drawstrings, black leggings, slim medium height

name: Pes Archie
description: Archie: friendly Staffordshire Bull Terrier dog, COMPACT athletic build — NOT heavily muscled or bulky, see reference photos for his true lean proportions. SOLID warm reddish-brown/tan coat covering the body and ears — NOT tiger-striped, NOT brindled, one solid warm tan-brown color, no stripe patterning anywhere. A DISTINCT WHITE/PALE BLAZE starts as a white PATCH ON THE FOREHEAD (between and slightly above the eyes) and runs straight down the bridge of the nose, covering most of the muzzle/snout up to the black nose — this white forehead-patch-plus-muzzle blaze is his single most identifying feature and must always be present (this REPLACES any dark mask — there is NO dark mask, NO dark shading around the eyes, the rest of the top of the head beyond that forehead patch is the same solid tan-brown as the rest of the coat). Folded/floppy tan ears (not erect, not cropped). Black nose. A plain white patch on the chest — a simple irregular white patch, NOT heart-shaped, no deliberate symbol or silhouette, just an ordinary marking. White on the paws (front paws especially). Black collar with small gold/brass studs and a small round red tag hanging from it. A SMALL-TO-MEDIUM sized dog, NOT large and NOT bulky — standing on all fours his shoulder height is well under half the height of even the smallest child in the family; scale him closer to a Beagle than a Labrador. This size is CONSTANT regardless of pose or camera distance — sitting, lying down, or close to the camera, his body must still read as slim/compact and clearly smaller than the children next to him, not just when standing far away. Illustrations often draw dogs oversized for a cute look — resist that instinct here, he must read as clearly small in EVERY scene. Happy, gentle expression, warm brown eyes, tongue out when panting.

name: James
description: James: boy with straight CHESTNUT-BROWN hair with a fringe (a warm medium brown, lighter than Jan's dark espresso-brown), dark brown eyes, fair light skin, cheeky warm smile, green T-shirt with cartoon dog print, white shorts, black sneakers with orange laces; Nicolas's best friend from Riverside school, exactly the SAME height AND the same 6-year-old school-age child proportions as Nicolas — not a teenager, not older-looking than Nicolas in any way

name: Bella
description: Bella: girl with very long straight CARAMEL-BROWN hair (a warm honey-brown between blonde and brown), blue-grey eyes, fair light skin, bright friendly smile, small shell earrings, cream sweatshirt, blue-grey shorts, pink sneakers; James's big sister, a school-age CHILD a few years older than James and Nicolas — about half a head taller than them (who are the same height as each other) — but still clearly a CHILD, not a teenager or a young adult

name: Eva
description: Eva: adult woman with BRONDE hair (a brown-blonde tone between Jana's pale blonde and James's chestnut brown) slicked back into a neat low bun, shaped dark eyebrows, blue-grey eyes, fair light skin, soft gentle smile with mauve lips, white ribbed tank top with a thin blue-striped trim, blue-and-white pinstriped skirt, small gold wristwatch, slim medium height

name: Jakob
description: Jakob: adult man with short slightly wavy CHESTNUT-BROWN hair (same warm brown family as James, noticeably lighter than Jan's dark espresso-brown), bright blue eyes, fair light skin, light brown stubble, big warm friendly smile, plain white T-shirt, slim tall build
